learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate effective leadership and communication strategies to liaise with project managers, contractors, arrangers, investors and other stakeholders.
Evaluate the challenges of measuring the risks and returns for private (non-listed) assets.
Develop investment valuations, fund/operating structures, including the role of debt financing, syndication and contractual risk mitigation arrangements, and cash flow models.
Analyse real estate and infrastructure origination, structuring, financing, and management with a group of your peers.
Apply a storytelling approach to share Indigenous perspectives on history and place.

assessments.task_description: Students will be required to apply the knowledge and skills acquired during the initial online/self-directed learning content. They will respond to a range of questions relating to fundamental Real estate and Infrastructure concepts via Blackboard, to be submitted by the specified due date and time.
assessments.deferral_or_extension: You may be able to apply for an extension.
assessments.late_submission: Exams submitted after the end of the submission time will incur a late penalty.
assessments.additional_info: You may be able to apply for an extension.

assessments.task_description:
On Day 3 of the face-to -face course you will work on an oral presentation. You will be assessed on your group collaboration and the quality of the answers you present on the day. You will be provided with details of an infrastructure/real estate project and expected to address challenges, impacts and potential outcomes.

Please Note: The presentation will be recorded for marking purposes per UQ Policy.

You will be provided the opportunity for peer feedback.
assessments.submission_guidelines: Assessment will be presented in a live environment.
assessments.deferral_or_extension: You may be able to apply for an extension.
assessments.late_submission: A penalty of 10% of the maximum possible mark will be deducted per 24 hours from time submission is due for up to 7 days. After 7 days, you will receive a mark of 0.
assessments.additional_info: You may be able to apply for an extension.

assessments.task_description: Following completion of the online content and face-to-face sessions, students will be required to apply knowledge and skills to analyse an authentic case study and provide recommendations to highlight ways to minimise the challenges, maximise impact, and optimise investment returns. This assessment is to be completed individually and submitted via Blackboard.

assessments.additional_info: You may be able to apply for an extension.
